name: blast-radius
description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

holdMinutes.title: Minutes to wait for an answer
holdMinutes.description: How long a held command waits for Proceed or Cancel before it is refused (1 to 1440).

autoSkip.title: Skip the pane for temporary files
autoSkip.description: off: hold every rm -r/-f (default). rules: run an rm of this session's scratchpad, or of nothing, without the pane. rules+model: also ask a decision model about the rest.

caution.title: How sure the model must be
caution.description: low, medium or high (0.8, 0.9, 0.97), or a number from 0 to 1: the model's rating needed to skip the pane.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Needed for rules+model. Kept in secure storage.
